_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); rules: the evergreen protocol's TESTING.md. Prompts run from the repository root.

evals.prompt: Shoot my lighthouse AI short like 1970s New Hollywood, 2.39.
What would a Wong Kar-wai look be for my AI music video, in terms I can actually put into the video prompts?
Who won the Academy Award for best director in 1975?
expectations: the cinewright-history skill is not invoked (film trivia, nothing to shoot)

evals.prompt: Write a 500-word essay on the French New Wave for my film studies class.
expectations: the cinewright-history skill is not invoked (an essay, not a look for generated video)

evals.prompt: Make a chart of 1970s New Hollywood box office by year.
expectations: the cinewright-history skill is not invoked (a chart, chartwright's job)

evals.prompt: out/nh is a copy of examples/three-shot. Make out/nh look like 1970s New Hollywood in a 2.39 frame, and show me how the compiled Veo prompt for shot 1B changes.
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below (a tool call in the trace), not by the reply saying so
evals.baseline: 2026-10-05, S6 matrix (evals/run_evals.py (claude -p --restricted, dontAsk, fresh folder on another drive); skills disabled), one run per model: without the skill 0 of 3 passed (Haiku fail, Sonnet fail, Opus fail).

evals.prompt: out/kubrick is a copy of examples/three-shot. Make it look like a Stanley Kubrick film while keeping it renderable, change any card that breaks that look, then compile the Veo prompts into out/kubrick/compiled/veo.
expectations: check: the style bible stays 16:9, names the kubrick card in history and sets allowed_moves and lens_family; continuity diff has no errors and no MOVE or LENS warnings; no compiled Veo prompt or style field names Kubrick (evals/check_kubrick.py exits 0)
judge: the look is carried by concrete devices (for example one-point perspective, symmetry, a wide lens close, slow dolly or Steadicam), not by the director's name (2 of 3 votes)
